# Forge-X

> Forge-X is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0), unofficial firmware mod for the Flashforge Adventurer 5M and 5M Pro (AD5M) 3D printers. It runs on top of the stock firmware and adds Klipper with AD5M-specific fixes, Moonraker, Fluidd, Mainsail, a built-in lightweight touchscreen (Feather), guided calibration, print-safety features, Power Loss Recovery, a low-memory camera service, OTA updates, and recovery tools. It is designed for the printer's 128 MiB of RAM and can be fully removed.

Key facts:
- Supported printers: Flashforge Adventurer 5M and Adventurer 5M Pro only.
- Supported stock firmware: every version from 2.6.5 up to 5.1.7 (the newest checked). The stock firmware version does not matter unless the Stock screen is used: the Linux system, kernel, base libraries and the MCU firmware are the same across versions, and a firmware update mainly replaces the Stock screen application (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md). For the Stock screen, firmware 3.1.x is recommended as the most stable while printing; versions newer than 3.1.x are needed only for the FlashForge cloud services.
- Klipper: the FlashForge host Klipper (0.11 generation) with reviewed backports of upstream Klipper fixes; MCU firmware is not reflashed.
- Web interfaces: Fluidd (/fluidd/), Mainsail (/mainsail/), Moonraker API on port 7125. SSH: root / root.
- Local screens: Feather (default, built in), Stock, Guppy Screen, Headless.
- Camera: forge-x-streamer, a dedicated low-memory MJPEG service.
- Safety and recovery: last-known-good boot guard, recovery menu, fallback to the stock firmware, uninstaller and recovery images, per-file .bak backups of patched Klipper files.
- Testing before releases: automated host tests, rendered G-code macro tests, visual UI tests, on-printer tests, and physical print tests.
- Klipper patch provenance: the replaced Klipper files are published as Git history (upstream v0.11.0, the stock FlashForge changes, then Forge-X commits) at https://github.com/DrA1ex/klipper-ad5m; docs/klipper-ad5m-manifest.json lists the SHA-256 of every shipped file and tests/verify_klipper_fork.py checks them against that repository. The history is reconstructed by topic; see docs/KLIPPER.md.
- Design choice: Forge-X keeps the vendor-compatible Klipper host and MCU firmware (no MCU reflash) and backports newer upstream fixes and features, because a full Klipper 0.13 is not needed at the moment (it can be adopted if a real need appears).
- Customization: own macros and overrides in user.cfg, own dialogs on the Feather screen (Klipper action:prompt messages), shell commands, own startup services (S* scripts in /etc/init.d of the Forge-X chroot), user.moonraker.conf, Entware packages, Headless mode with custom displays.
- Updates: Forge-X, Fluidd, Mainsail, and Guppy Screen update separately through Moonraker Update Manager.
- Boot safety: the installed boot guard (.shell/S00init) is replaced only after the new runtime reports ready; an interrupted or failed initialization boots the stock firmware on the next start.
- Configuration changes go through a parser (.py/cfg_backup.py) with declarative profiles, backup, restore, and verify, not through ad-hoc text edits.
- Motion limits for parking moves are held in one macro, MOVE_SAFE. Power Loss Recovery is Python source in the repository (resurrection.py).
- Tests: dozens of host test modules run by CI (tests/run_host_tests.py), plus a real-printer regression runner and visual UI regression before releases.
- Firmware updater: HTTPS with certificate checks, .part file, size and tar validation, atomic replace; it does not verify SHA-256 or a signature.
- Release policy: releases are published when Forge-X itself changes; an upstream version bump of Moonraker, Klipper, Fluidd, or Mainsail alone is not a reason for a release. Fluidd, Mainsail, and Guppy update separately.
- Limitations: AD5M/AD5M Pro only; FlashForge Klipper 0.11 base with backports; Feather does not cover every task; real-printer tests are done by the maintainer before releases; not every combination of printer, stock firmware version, and configuration can be covered.
- License: GPL-3.0. Repository: https://github.com/DrA1ex/ff5m
